title: SDK2 private logical cache continuity candidate v0.2
$comment: Unreleased independent SDK2 contract; SDK1/TWP/IR unchanged. Named DTO validation required. Public, gateway-only and host-only definitions have different authority and cannot be interchanged based on root anyOf. TTL/authorization/CAS/durable transaction/byte caps are runtime obligations.

LegacyId.description: Existing opaque ID; no trimming, case folding or Unicode normalization. Do not mint authority from this string.

Sequence.description: Canonical unsigned decimal 0..2^63-1. Never parse through IEEE754 Number.

Coverage.$comment: Closed inclusive interval, from<=through. Head is a host-known contiguous chain commitment for this source and generation, not a client assertion. SSE cursor is never archive coverage.

Scope.$comment: Host/API-owned only. Public request scope is derived from current authentication, never body/OS/platform labels. Application and original end-user remain a tuple. Core scope uses its real authorization revision; gateway scope uses null because the API does not know it. Identity is always the original application/user tuple; neither revision nor HMAC substitutes for current authentication.

EpochView.$comment: Trusted host initialization/independent rotator durably prepares current epoch. GET reads snapshot and never mints/renews one. No current live epoch => epoch_unavailable for admission. Rotation disables old write admission, never hides already admitted operation status; retired/unknown IDs cannot be recreated from requests. S1 epoch lifetime defaults to 3600000ms, hard maximum 86400000ms; trusted host validates 0<expiresAt-issuedAt<=effective epochLifetimeMs. Terminal receipt cannot be collected before BOTH epoch expiry and terminal retention expiry; unresolved operations remain. An active epoch is never a license to recreate a collected request ID.

Ticket.$comment: 32 random bytes, canonical base64url without padding. Scope/audience-bound reference, not self-asserted authority; never log or use as provider key.

MutationReceipt.$comment: Immutable original result, not current authorization or current binding state. Atomic mapping/ticket/revision/receipt commit. Replay under current authority precedes fresh epoch/CAS; never renew TTL on replay.

ProjectionWitness.$comment: Trusted core/provider output only, not a public write request. Immutable effective projection reference, never raw-history reinsertion or external summary authority. HMAC inputs are original IR/provider bytes, not control JSON encoding. Domain/scope/key/context must match before comparison. Core and gateway witness domains are tagged and non-comparable. Gateway has no core generations/assembler/coverage. Its serializerVersion names the actual TWP parser/serializer contract, not a claimed core version.

ProjectionPublish.$comment: Internal synchronous prepare/persist/publish with current history/policy/source guard; no public route. Core acceptance and immutable projection reference commit together or remain unknown, never install stale projected state.

ExchangeMetadata.$comment: Gateway route only: 4-byte big-endian metadata length + canonical metadata <=64KiB + unchanged original TWP UTF-8 body <=32MiB. SHA is raw transport integrity, never a diagnostic fingerprint. Existing TWP body schema and original auth/signature/idempotency/usage remain required; new operation semantic identity additionally binds this immutable envelope. Never decode/reencode inner bytes for retry.

MappingRecord.$comment: Durable authoritative multi-instance CAS record; only mapping metadata, no prompts/provider credentials. Scope tuple+logicalRef unique, versioned transactions; cache/Redis is not authoritative. Terminal/ticket rows separately bounded and atomically linked. No runtime lease or billing identity substitution.

Diagnostic.$comment: No prompts, raw/HMAC fingerprints, raw app/user identities, tickets, raw groupRef, provider keys, request body digests or unbounded messages. Correlating prefix equality is not a cache-hit assertion. Same-scope diagnostics permission and caps on every page/read.

RebindRequest.$comment: Current owner authentication plus trusted persisted session/logical lineage, not a bare claimed sessionId; may replace expired/rotated device ticket only while mapping and binding remain active and current policy/deletion witnesses match. No resurrection of revoked/closed/expired mapping.

RecordSequence.$comment: Record ordinals start at 1. Zero is only an empty published/acknowledged watermark, never a record ordinal.

PolicyRefresh.$comment: Trusted host-only current authority/source facts; never public input. Same-transaction CAS rotates group generation and revokes all tickets, or revokes mapping. Source/deletion/authorization boundary changes require revoke; a harmless still-authorized policy refresh may rotate then permit lineage-verified rebind. No ticket alone can authorize this transition. Gateway observations update only the same witness domain with a strictly newer observationRevision. Authorization boundary change still revokes. Observation change rotates without claiming a core prompt/memory/source generation. Core policy refresh follows existing logical-turn and governance publication barriers.

GatewayLink.$comment: Host-only durable outbox link. Reserve local key and exact protected gateway intent before remote mutation; current auth remains separate. Query/replay same remote key after unknown outcome; never transfer the public serve audience ticket to gateway. Active requires known committed remote binding, revision and protected gateway ticket. Counts toward all retained-state budgets; pending is never TTL-GCed.

CorePolicyWitness.$comment: Trusted core effective logical-turn revisions only. No gateway inference, placeholder revision, mid-turn system refresh or public write authority.

GatewayPolicyWitness.$comment: Gateway-owned durable observation CAS revision, not any core revision. HMACs witness currently observed authorized platform facts but never grant authority. Core revisions are explicitly unknown; a separately authenticated delegation contract is not provided by this candidate.

GatewayInputWitness.$comment: Computed by the trusted gateway from validated original input and actual final member request bytes. No control JSON normalization of IR/parameters. Current platform configuration is a separate GatewayPolicyWitness fact; it cannot replace the effective system in the fixed logical turn.

FinancialAnchor.$comment: Trusted old financial identity: (owner_type, owner_id, twp:<original inner.meta.requestId>). Never derive a replacement from app/user/runtime/envelope or cache/HMAC key versions. This DTO does not create a new ledger.

GatewayAdmissionIdentity.$comment: Host-only exact witnessed identity. Runtime must derive innerRequestId from the validated original TWP, require financialAnchor.requestId === twp: + innerRequestId, derive scope and owner from current authentication, and validate all lengths/SHA against the full frame. Never accept client hashes as authority. Public ExchangeMetadata is unchanged.

GatewayAdmissionRecord.$comment: Durable non-financial admission anchor unique by the original FinancialAnchor. not-required means the original gateway confirms no reservation at all, not merely zero cash. Positive gross covered by gifted Tokens still requires existing-reservation with its original token_state/hold, even if reservation.amountMicro is zero. First anchor + any original reservation/Token hold + mapping idle touch commit atomically on one DB connection; Redis is not this authority. Existing accepted/unknown records are historical facts only, never provider execution permits. Pending cannot be GCed; terminal retention must keep a bounded denial anchor while original IDs could be submitted again.
